RunFacts()
| where created_at between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where isnull(_workflow) or array_length(_workflow) == 0 or workflow_name in (_workflow)
| summarize runs = count(),
            ok = countif(conclusion == "success"),
            done = countif(isnotempty(conclusion)),
            repos = dcount(repository_id),
            workflows = dcount(workflow_name)
| extend p = toscalar((JobFacts()
| where queued_at between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| lookup kind=leftouter (RunFacts() | project run_id, attempt, workflow_name) on run_id, attempt
| where isnull(_workflow) or array_length(_workflow) == 0 or workflow_name in (_workflow)
    | where runner_kind != "unknown"
    | where queue_seconds >= 0
    | summarize percentile(queue_seconds, 95)))
| extend Rows = pack_array(
    pack_array("Runs", tostring(runs)),
    pack_array("Success rate", iff(done == 0, "--", strcat(tostring(round(100.0 * ok / done, 1)), "%"))),
    pack_array("Queue p95", strcat(tostring(coalesce(p, 0)), "s")),
    pack_array("Active repos", tostring(repos)),
    pack_array("Workflows", tostring(workflows)))
| mv-expand Rows
| project title = tostring(Rows[0]), value = tostring(Rows[1])

JobFacts()
| where queued_at between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| lookup kind=leftouter (RunFacts() | project run_id, attempt, workflow_name) on run_id, attempt
| where isnull(_workflow) or array_length(_workflow) == 0 or workflow_name in (_workflow)
| where runner_kind != "unknown"
| where queue_seconds >= 0
| extend Label = tostring(parse_json(labels)[0])
| summarize Jobs = count(),
            ["Queue p50"] = percentile(queue_seconds, 50),

            ["Exec p50"] = percentile(exec_seconds, 50),
            ["Runners seen"] = dcount(runner_name)
  by Label, Kind = runner_kind
| where Jobs >= 10
| order by ["Queue p95"] desc

JobFacts()

RunFacts()

| where Failed > 0
| extend ["Fail %"] = round(100.0 * Failed / Runs, 1)
| project Workflow, Runs, Failed, ["Fail %"], ["Wasted min"]

RunFacts()
| where created_at between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where isnull(_workflow) or array_length(_workflow) == 0 or workflow_name in (_workflow)
| where conclusion == "success" and wall_seconds > 0
| join kind=inner (JobFacts()
| where queued_at between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| lookup kind=leftouter (RunFacts() | project run_id, attempt, workflow_name) on run_id, attempt
| where isnull(_workflow) or array_length(_workflow) == 0 or workflow_name in (_workflow)
    | where runner_kind != "unknown"
    | summarize longest = max(exec_seconds), jobs = count() by run_id, attempt) on run_id, attempt
| extend overhead = wall_seconds - longest
| where overhead >= 0
| summarize Runs = count(), Jobs = percentile(jobs, 50),
            ["Overhead p50"] = percentile(overhead, 50),
            ["Overhead p95"] = percentile(overhead, 95),
            ["Total min"] = round(sum(overhead) / 60.0, 1)
  by Workflow = workflow_name
| where Runs >= 5
| top 15 by ["Total min"] desc

JobFacts()
| where queued_at between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| lookup kind=leftouter (RunFacts() | project run_id, attempt, workflow_name) on run_id, attempt
| where isnull(_workflow) or array_length(_workflow) == 0 or workflow_name in (_workflow)
| where runner_kind != "unknown"

let f = StepFacts()
| where started_at between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where isnull(_workflow) or array_length(_workflow) == 0 or workflow_name in (_workflow);
f
| summarize steps = count(), jobs = dcount(check_run_id), runs = dcount(run_id),

| extend Rows = pack_array(
    pack_array("Steps", tostring(steps)),

StepFacts()
| where started_at between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where isnull(_workflow) or array_length(_workflow) == 0 or workflow_name in (_workflow)
| where ran and not(synthetic)
| summarize runs = count(), workflows = dcount(workflow_name),
            p50 = percentile(duration_seconds, 50), p95 = percentile(duration_seconds, 95),
            max_s = max(duration_seconds), total_h = sum(duration_seconds) / 3600.0,
            failures = countif(step_conclusion == "failure") by step_name
| where runs >= 5
| top 20 by total_h desc
| project ["Step"] = step_name, ["Runs"] = runs, ["Workflows"] = workflows,
          ["p50 s"] = round(p50, 1), ["p95 s"] = round(p95, 1), ["Max s"] = round(max_s, 1),
          ["Total h"] = round(total_h, 1),
          ["Spread"] = strcat(tostring(round(iff(p50 > 0, p95 / p50, 0.0), 0)), "x"),
          ["Fail %"] = round(100.0 * failures / runs, 1)

StepFacts()
| where started_at between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where isnull(_workflow) or array_length(_workflow) == 0 or workflow_name in (_workflow)
| where ran
| summarize authored = sumif(duration_seconds, not(synthetic)),
            overhead = sumif(duration_seconds, synthetic) by check_run_id
| where authored + overhead > 0
| extend pct = 100.0 * overhead / (authored + overhead)
| summarize jobs = count(), ah = sum(authored) / 3600.0, oh = sum(overhead) / 3600.0,
            p50 = percentile(pct, 50), p90 = percentile(pct, 90), p99 = percentile(pct, 99)
| extend Rows = pack_array(
    pack_array("Jobs measured", tostring(jobs)),
    pack_array("Authored work", strcat(tostring(round(ah, 1)), " h")),
    pack_array("Runner overhead", strcat(tostring(round(oh, 1)), " h")),
    pack_array("Overhead share", strcat(tostring(round(100.0 * oh / (ah + oh), 1)), "%")),
    pack_array("Per job p50", strcat(tostring(round(p50, 1)), "%")),
    pack_array("Per job p90", strcat(tostring(round(p90, 1)), "%")),
    pack_array("Per job p99", strcat(tostring(round(p99, 1)), "%")))
| mv-expand Rows
| project ["Measure"] = tostring(Rows[0]), ["Value"] = tostring(Rows[1])

_ev

| where isempty(_repo) or repo == _repo

let _j = materialize(LiveJobs());
let _live_runs = toscalar(LiveRuns() | where not(phantom) | count);
_j
| summarize jobs = count(),
            starved = countif(not(label_served)),
            repos = dcount(repo, 4),
            age_seconds = max(age_seconds)
| extend age_seconds = coalesce(age_seconds, 0)
| extend longest = case(age_seconds < 90, strcat(tostring(age_seconds), "s"),

    pack_array("Starved", tostring(starved)),
    pack_array("Runs in flight", tostring(_live_runs)),

| where eventType in ("workflow_job_created", "workflow_job_completed")

| extend waiting = case(age_seconds < 90, strcat(tostring(age_seconds), "s"),

| extend state = iff(label_served, "in flight", "STARVED: no runner serves these labels")

LiveJobs()

| where not(phantom)

tiles.title: How to read this
tiles.markdownText:
Sourced from the **GitHub Actions Data Stream** (preview). Every tile honours the time range and workflow filters above.

- **Skipped jobs are excluded from timings.** They arrive with all-zero durations and are ~40% of rows, so leaving them in drags every average toward zero.
- **Negative queue times are dropped, not clamped.** `workflow_job_created` sometimes lands after the job started. Clamping to zero would hide the bias; dropping keeps the p50 honest.
- **These are not billable minutes.** The stream carries no cost fields. Durations are wall clock, and self-hosted time is free.
- **Names come from the stream, IDs do not resolve.** Repositories and actors are numeric ids only; join the REST API if you need `owner/repo`.

tiles.title: How to read this
tiles.markdownText:
These are **real steps**, resolved from the REST job API using `check_run_id` from the data stream. They are not `##[group]` markers scraped from logs — those matched real step names only 58% of the time, because one step can emit many groups and many steps emit none.

- **Synthetic steps are excluded from the time sinks.** `Set up job`, `Post *` and `Complete job` are runner overhead, not your CI. They get their own tile instead of drowning out authored work.
- **Skipped and cancelled jobs are absent by design.** They return `steps: []` from the API because they never executed. They were 43% of all job events.
- **Spread is p95 ÷ p50.** A high spread is a cache-miss story: the median run is fine and the tail is not. That is usually more actionable than a slow median.
- **A 100% failure rate is often `continue-on-error`.** Polling and label-check steps show up here legitimately. Read the failure count alongside the wasted hours.

tiles.title: How to read this
tiles.markdownText:
### Why this page exists

`sink_health` only advances on connection tests, so a sink that has delivered nothing
for an hour still reports `healthy`. **Health is failure-fast but success-blind** --
this page is the success signal.

- **Ingest lag** is `ingestion_time() - eventTimestamp`. Measured p50 ~5s, p95 ~7s.
  A sustained climb means the destination is backing up, not that GitHub is slow.
- **Duplicate events** should be 0. Delivery is at-least-once by contract, so a
  non-zero value here is expected behaviour, not an incident -- dedupe on `eventUuid`.
- **Dropped completions** are runs that emitted `created` and never `completed`
  because they dispatched no job. ~1.2% of runs. They are not stuck, they are gone.
- **Jobs skipped** is ~40% on a busy org. Skipped jobs carry all-zero timings and
  must be filtered before any duration maths -- `JobFacts()` exposes `ran` for this.

Zero events with a `healthy` sink is the alert worth wiring: `ActionsEvents | where
eventTimestamp > ago(30m) | count`.

tiles.title: How to read this
tiles.markdownText:
## What "live" means here, precisely

**The date range picker does not apply to this page.** Everything below is now.
Turn on auto-refresh (top right) to watch it move -- ingestion lag is p50 5s /
p95 7s, so this is genuinely near-real-time rather than a slow-moving report.

**There is no "job started" event.** The stream emits `workflow_job_created`
then `workflow_job_completed` and nothing in between, and `runner_name` is empty
on every created event (0 of 1,693 measured over 6h). So a job here is *queued
or executing* and nothing can tell you which, nor which runner picked it up.
Age is time-since-queued, never runtime.
[issue #21](https://github.com/austenstone/terraform-actions-data-stream/issues/21)

**So don't read age as "stuck".** A 40-minute job might be compiling or might be
waiting on a runner that will never come. `state` answers that instead: it asks
whether *any* job carrying the same labels has completed on a real runner in the
last 24 hours. If none has, the pool is dead -- a retired `ubuntu-20.04`, an ARC
deployment scaled to zero, a self-hosted box that never came back. Measured
live, this separated the population perfectly: every job open over 30 minutes
was starved, every job under 2 minutes was not.

**Waiting by label is the tile to alert on.** A label whose `waiting` count
climbs while `verdict` says NO RUNNER is a capacity outage in progress, and it
is visible here minutes before anyone opens a support ticket.

**Runs in flight hides phantoms.** A run that emitted `created`, never emitted
`completed`, and has no in-flight jobs is not running -- it either lost its
completion event or died before dispatching anything. Those are filtered out
here and diagnosed properly on Stream health.
[issue #8](https://github.com/austenstone/terraform-actions-data-stream/issues/8)
